derivation: from a form of G3485 (ναός) and (to sweep);
def: a temple-servant, i.e. (by implication) a votary

occurrences.text: And when the townclerk had appeased the people, he said, Ye men of Ephesus, what man is there that knoweth not how that the city of the Ephesians is a worshipper of the great goddess Diana, and of the image which fell down from Jupiter?
